aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases both upside and drawdown potential due to higher leverage and concentration in volatile assets. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this mode can lose a lot fast without strict stop discipline.
